def evolved_cig(c, N, rank, world_size, num_devices,
                 cores_per_device, xm, torch, num_nodes=1):
    # Formula: c[i, j] = j  -> each column filled with its column index.
    # Position-based, depends only on j. No collective needed.
    idx = torch.arange(N, device=c.device)
    jj = idx.view(1, N).expand(N, N)
    return jj.contiguous().to(c.dtype)
